package.name: single_cam_pose_estimation
package.description: Monocular model-based 6-DoF hand-pose estimation. For each camera in a YAML-defined list, fit T_world_hand by PnP on MediaPipe's hand-local model (handpose3d_msgs/HandLandmarks 2D + world landmarks) using calibration_multi_cam intrinsics/extrinsics, place the 21 joints in the world frame, and publish the skeleton (RViz), the 21 joints (PoseArray), the 6-DoF hand pose (PoseStamped + TF), and a reprojection QA overlay. Each camera is estimated independently, so several views' estimates can be compared.
